## Problem and outcome

Who benefits, what problem does this solve, and what changes for them? Link the relevant issue.

## Changes

Describe the implementation and any compatibility or operational implications.

## Verification

List lint/typecheck results and relevant manual checks. Include screenshots for interface changes. Explain anything not verified. Do not add or run tests under the current project policy.

## Documentation

For a user-facing change, link the companion pull request on [nieve-consulting/lumi-docs](https://github.com/nieve-consulting/lumi-docs) that updates the documentation. State “None” when not applicable.

## Generated files and database changes

Identify code generation performed and generated migrations awaiting developer application. State “None” when not applicable. Do not apply migrations or publish a release as part of preparing this pull request.
